narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs hid in the warning noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `options.retries` is now `retryCount` | accept both |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | treat as `false` |

The 8 warnings left are true deprecation notices. They name real code, like `Buffer()` and `crypto.createCipher`.

Next: clear those deprecations if you want a silent log.
